question: Simplify (x - 3)² + (x + 3)² .
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Using the standard algebraic identity: (a − b)² + (a + b)² = 2(a² + b²) Here, substituting a = x and b = 3 directly into the formula: ⇒ (x − 3)² + (x + 3)² = 2(x² + 3²) ⇒ 2(x² + 9) = 2x² + 18 **∴ The correct answer is 2x² + 18.**
